experiment: card-only per-horse score, product/Plackett-Luce trifecta approximation, age bands separated (t267u+t268u)
preregistration_note: Written before any model fit or evaluation metric was computed. No feature, hyperparameter, band rule or BOX rule is changed after seeing evaluation results.

data.2022_warmup: /workspace/banma_lambda_confidence_experiment/inputs/canonical_races.json (2022 only; actual starters only, no scratched-horse identities)
data.2023_onward: /workspace/banma_official_pdf_audit_2023_onward/clean_results_2023_onward.json (status final; 2023Q1 432R not PDF-verified -> sensitivity run excluding them)

age_bands.race_typing: pure_Y: all actual starters Y; pure_O: all actual starters O; mixed: both present
age_bands.training: band model fitted only on pure races of that band (no shared coefficients, separate standardization)
age_bands.primary_eval: pure_Y and pure_O races evaluated separately, each with its own model
age_bands.mixed_races: secondary/exploratory only: each horse scored by its OWN band model linear predictor, plus one offset delta for Y horses fitted (1-parameter PL) on prior mixed races only; reported separately, never pooled into band results

features_card_only.w_rel: sled weight minus mean sled weight of same-band actual starters in race (card)
features_card_only.w_delta_prev: sled weight minus horse's previous-start sled weight (prior dates only)
features_card_only.w_minus_best_top3: sled weight minus max sled weight at which horse previously finished top3 (prior dates); missing->0 + flag
features_card_only.age_months: months from birth_date to race date (card)
features_card_only.form_last1: normalized finish (finish-1)/(n-1) of last start, prior dates only
features_card_only.form_avg3: mean normalized finish of last 3 starts
features_card_only.win_rate5: wins in last 5 starts, shrunk (w+0.1)/(k+1)... implemented as (wins+prior*2)/(k+2) with prior=0.12
features_card_only.no_history: 1 if no prior start in data
features_card_only.class_change: ladder value(current race) - ladder value(previous start), negative = promoted to higher class; 0 + flag if ladders differ/unknown
features_card_only.scratch_hist: log1p(#withdrawn/excluded entries of this horse in prior 180 days) -- identities only available from 2023, so 0 throughout 2022 warmup (documented bias)
excluded_from_score: official assigned-class membership tables (t262 actual membership; not used)

scratch_handling: withdrawn/excluded horses removed from candidates (status known before post time); DNF/DQ starters remain candidates

model.type: linear utility u=x.beta, Plackett-Luce top-3 likelihood, L2 lambda=1.0 per feature (standardized with training-window stats), L-BFGS

variants.M2_secondary: M1 + jockey prior-365d top3 rate shrunk (prior 0.30, k=10)

model.walk_forward: monthly expanding window: model for eval month M fit on races with date < first day of M (2022 warmup included); features for every race computed from strictly earlier dates only

box_rules.BOX_PL: 3-horse set maximizing sum of 6 PL ordered probabilities p_i*p_j/(1-p_i)*p_k/(1-p_i-p_j)
box_rules.BOX_PROD: plain product normalization p(i,j,k) ∝ p_i p_j p_k -> top-3 by p
box_rules.top_ticket: single ordered triple with max PL probability (exact trifecta)
box_rules.primary_metric: BOX_PL hit rate (any of 6 tickets equals an official trifecta combination)

baselines_same_races: simple rule: best form_avg3 (no-history = 0.5), ties by lower w_rel
C lambda walk-forward BOX (/workspace/anauma/chaos_lambda/lambda_box_walkforward.json) where available; different information set
reference only (not card info): popularity top3 BOX
metrics: mean # of actual top3 in BOX
ROI reference 600 yen/R BOX, 100 yen top ticket

bootstrap.outputs: mean, 95% percentile CI, paired differences vs baselines, share of draws with diff>0 (bootstrap frequency, not a future probability)

leakage_audit: for sampled eval dates D, randomize finishes/statuses of all races dated >= D and re-run feature build + monthly fit; predictions for date D must be bit-identical (prior days within the same month legitimately feed horse history)
